answer: Each identity must lock collateral in a public quartz vault and keep a unique hardware key online for random live checks. The network places identities on a credit ridge: payouts cannot exceed the lesser of bonded stake and a slowly accrued work score. Scores do not transfer across keys, and keys funded from the same rail share one accrual cap. Independent graders form a trellis so no rater can whitewash a farm; failed exclusive-control checks slash stake and score. An attacker must buy many devices, post capital, and wait out real time per identity, not mint free keypairs.
